notes: Plan 32 stage 4 (DEC-315): the format of the fruit drama recipe (recipes/fruit_drama.json: 60-90 s, 4-6 scenes). One conflict told in 5 scenes on episode 1 (the hook, three body beats setup / rising / peak, the cliffhanger) and 6 with the recap from episode 2 (default_body_count 3; scenes [4, 6] lets the plan's fit drop to 2 body beats when a link's clips cannot fit 90 s, never below 4 scenes). Each scene is 1-2 shots of 5-10 s (shots_per_scene, min_shot_s, max_shot_s: the native shot window, DEC-304): the recap 5-6 s, the hook 5-10 s, a body beat 14-20 s (two shots), the cliffhanger 6-10 s, so a default plan on 6/8 s clips (Veo, an upload) lasts 64 s on episode 1 and 70 s on episode 2 before the end card, and the target is 75 s, tightening above 85 s. One silent reaction shot a scene (reaction_shots [1, 1]) lets a fruit's face carry the beat after its line. end_card_s 1.5 matches the recipe's end card ('Partie {n} demain', 1.5 s; the recipe asks for the card even when the style's cliffhanger is hard_stop, steps/script.py sets the script's cut_to_black from it), and end_card_cta puts the recipe's line on it. No narrator fields: the fruits speak in their own voices. The format fruit_drama's style suggests (episode_defaults.episode_template_id) and the fruit_drama preset sets; still a per-story choice (DEC-268).
